abilities.name: Cultivate plants
abilities.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
abilities.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

execution.progress: Three paid one-round stages; job, reserved unit and plot persist across interruption; resuming pays only the remaining stages after revalidation; completion, failure, cancelling and death settle once. Growth runs only in ordinary simulation.

Every round is checked before any charge; prepare resumes your paused work (inputStackId and quantity may be omitted). Inspect (inputStackId of your own food) and inspect-progress (your latest preparation): one round, 0.2 energy, no food used. Cancel: one round, no energy. No vessel, water, fuel, tool or ground surface is used or given. Eating and giving use eat and give at their own costs.
abilities.effects: Each paid round separates one whole unit from the input, checks it by eye and brushes it by hand, held, never set on the ground. A usable unit joins one owned lot of the same food with unchanged quantity, origin, age, decay, nutrition and toxicity, recorded as raw, unheated, dry-brushed, safety unknown. Loose soil on food is not represented, so no debris is measured or removed and no cleanliness is claimed. A spoiled unit is reported unsuitable, stays unprepared and ends the work. Nothing is cooked, peeled, washed, made safe or kept fresher; food keeps ageing, and the planting trial treats prepared units as processed. The lot holds only completed units. Inspections record visible condition, treatment and your own eating record (not a safety test) as an unverified personal record. An unworked round, too little energy, or an input no longer yours with a whole unit pauses without charge. Cancel or death ends the work; completed units stay. No refund or reward; nobody is fed.

General operation: assess or thermally prepare an owned food quantity, inspect work, or cancel. Parameters: exact inputStackId, quantity, mode, and, when heating, exact sourceId, support/tool/vessel IDs and recipe/evidence reference if one actually exists. Do not bind the operation to Kai or roots. Reuse probe observation semantics and existing inventory, ageing, ownership, work and event code; reuse unheated-food-preparation handling code only where applicable, without treating brushing as cooking. Minimal executable precursor: assess costs one active simulation round and 0.2 energy, consumes no food or fuel, and requires the selected item to be within actual observation/handling reach. Report directly observable condition, existing treatment records and which explicitly supplied prerequisites are unverified or absent from the inspected arrangement. Do not search hidden inventory or world resources. The initial result may state that no usable heat source or cooking arrangement has been demonstrated; it must not claim none exists anywhere. A failed precondition check costs no material or energy and performs no work. Assessment never labels the roots edible or cooked.
Thermal mode requires an actual reachable heat source, a physically workable means of exposing and retrieving the selected food without unsupported safe bare-hand contact, and any method-specific tools, food-contact surface, vessel or water. A waterless method need not require a vessel or water if an actual supported arrangement exists. Ignition is a prerequisite only where the actual heat source requires it; a branch alone supplies neither ignition nor guaranteed fuel suitability. No tasting trial is used to establish safety. Movement, gathering, acquisition, ignition and communication remain separate actual actions, not free substeps.
Implement missing heat-transfer/source support in this same development handoff if no reusable mechanism exists. Until that support is executable, assessment remains available and heating reports the specific dependency unavailable, without charging a heating round. Do not invent a facility, fire, recipe or sequence of future unlocks. The heating dependency must define simulation-round duration, resource mass/thermal properties, source output, fuel consumption, transfer losses and exposure geometry before enabling thermal mode. These must be explicit versioned code constants or measured represented inputs, not model guesses on each call. No successful cooking claim from an arbitrary fixed timer.
Heating costs one active round and 0.5 actor energy per supervised work round, plus measured source energy and actual fuel consumed under that source's published code. Setup and safe removal each require one active round and 0.5 energy when physically applicable. Reserve, do not duplicate, the selected quantity. Log elapsed exposure and delivered heat each round, conserving source energy into food, apparatus and environmental losses. Fuel becomes represented combustion products and residues according to the source model; water loss becomes vapor, food loss becomes residue or waste. Preserve original food identity, origin, age, decay, untreated hazards and quantity accounting through splits. Report measured heating, softening, drying, scorching or spoilage only when modeled and actually reached. Never reset decay, grant nutrition, remove toxins or infer edibility merely from heating. A validated processing rule may change a particular hazard only when its exact evidence reference, food applicability and required conditions are met; otherwise safety remains unknown. Eating uses eat separately with actual nutrition and toxicity.
Persist work ID, input and apparatus references, reserved quantities, mode, accumulated active rounds, exposure, temperature where represented, consumption, observations and status. Recheck ownership, reach, energy and physical prerequisites before each charge. An unworked round or lost prerequisite pauses actor work without an extra work charge; passive heat transfer, ageing, combustion and hazards continue only through their real ongoing process rules. Pause is not automatic safe removal or extinguishing. Resume rechecks current arrangement and continues from actual state, not from a pristine input. Cancel costs one round and no actor energy, stops further intentional handling, releases reservations once and leaves food, hot apparatus and source in their actual locations and states. Death ends personal work and releases reservations without teleporting items or extinguishing a fire. Completed changes and consumed fuel/time/energy are never refunded; unused material is retained, not recreated. No maintenance is free: additional fuel, source tending and safe repositioning require actual inputs and actions. After implementation, established validation, progress, effects and lifecycle rules execute in code without repeated model review. Review/development waiting advances no simulation time.
